# Peanut-GB (original Game Boy / DMG)

Upstream: https://github.com/deltabeard/Peanut-GB
Pinned commit: `d0bcca771c83a2638c93a9ae61f3d51f226dc905`.
MIT, including the MIT SameBoy-derived portions; see LICENSE and header preamble.

This core supports DMG, not Game Boy Color. The frontend rejects CGB-only ROMs.
Sound is disabled in this first frontend; LCD, input, MBC1/2/3/5 and battery saves
are implemented. No game ROMs or Nintendo boot ROM are distributed.
